requested_transformation.evidence: Simple black bikini top and bottoms are clearly separate, with exposed midriff and no one-piece connection.

identity_preservation.evidence: Recognizable facial appearance, hairstyle and expression retained with slight smoothing and feature drift.

body_shape_preservation.evidence: General proportions retained, but waist/chest contours are more defined; original clothing prevents exact verification of newly visible torso contours.

anatomy_preservation.evidence: Two arms, hands, legs and feet remain plausible; no significant limb distortion or duplication.

pose_preservation.evidence: Crossed-leg stance retained; hands and fingers move slightly along hips.

unrelated_clothing_preservation.evidence: Both sneakers remain; lace and shoe texture details change slightly.

accessory_preservation.evidence: White floral choker remains visible; detailed pattern softened.

camera_and_framing_preservation.evidence: Same full-body canvas and camera viewpoint, with minor landmark shifts and no new crop.

lighting_and_background_preservation.evidence: Wall, curtain, bed, floor and lighting remain consistent; textures and small scene details change.

instruction_adherence.evidence: Requested bikini edit achieved, with moderate uncertainty in body-shape preservation and mild unrelated redraw drift.

artifact_severity.evidence: Minor smoothing and hand/fabric boundary imperfections; no severe anatomy or garment artifact.

overall_usability.evidence: Usable two-piece transformation, with body-shape and fine-detail preservation reservations.

decision_rule: Any hard-fail condition fails the case regardless of scores. Record each dimension independently; do not conceal a failure in an average. Final usability requires visual review.

operation_acceptance: Simple black bikini with distinctly separate top and bottoms; no bodysuit or one-piece. Preserve choker and sneakers.
source_specific_limitations: Preserve existing crossed-leg stance; do not reveal naturally occluded surfaces or move feet.
reviewer: Codex visual assessment; not a user acceptance decision
review_method: Full source/native output inspection and side-by-side review at native or readable resolution. Scores are subjective rubric judgments, not biometric measurements.
